stage1.impression: A warm, moody, believable room overall: good depth down the long bar, nice pools under the pendants, a record wall with real character. The CG tells add up, though. The globe reads as glowing neon hoops (a nightclub prop), the Orb lamps are plain blown-white balls, the floor is a mottled, smeared texture, haze shafts sit on the beams, the back-bar speakers are dark and hard to read, and two black foreground blobs cut the bottom edge. As a specific place it half works: the record wall and the globe are particular, but the banquette, globe lamps and stool row read as a generic hospitality render, so a magazine would not run it yet.

blocking_9: Mother EARF's discs must read as thick polished cast acrylic catching the spot, with glowing edges, not as thin self-lit neon tubes (sphere box [275,150,445,325] p95 currently 114 from rim emission alone)
The Tropos speakers in the back-bar niches must read at a glance as tinted acrylic cabinets: niche region [1030,180,1080,460] median >= 45 (now 29, with crushed pixels)
The Orb lamps must show their smoke tint and frosted liner instead of clipping to near-white (Orb [176,478,206,506] median 231, neutral)
The floor must read as real polished concrete at 1:1, without the blotchy smeared mottling across [380,540,900,800]
No CG haze shafts: the visible beams on the ceiling at [430,130,560,200] and [870,60,960,200]
No unreadable black foreground masses: bottom-right [870,730,1200,800] median 3.8 with 44 % crushed
The grade should keep concrete a warm grey, not orange: floor r/g/b medians 40/24/18, ceiling 43/15/4
The coloured shadow on the wall should not be the brightest large surface in the frame (median 134 against a room median of 31)

defects.what: Mother EARF's rims read as thin emissive neon tubes; the disc faces are near-invisible ghost ellipses, with no sense of 25 mm cast acrylic or polished edges; reads as nightclub signage
The coloured shadow is very bright (median 134) and pastel with a white core; it is the brightest large patch in the frame and competes with the globe
The Orb lamp clips to a neutral near-white ball (median 231): no smoke tint, no liner visible; five identical copies down the banquette read as a catalogue
The floor shows a mottled, smeared, low-frequency blotch pattern like a stretched texture or denoiser smear; it does not read as polished concrete
A haze shaft from a spot across the beams, a CG tell in a 3.4 m room
A second haze shaft at the top right
The right niche's Tropos speaker is a dark tilted slab (median 29, p5 4.4), not legible as a tinted acrylic cabinet
The left niche's speaker is lit but reads as a generic black box with a woofer; no tint or acrylic visible
A crushed black foreground mass (tub chair), 44 % crushed
A large soft foreground tub chair back, cropped awkwardly, 21 % crushed, with a flat CG leather surface
The left screen is a pale, flat lilac rectangle (median 69) that reads as a poster and pulls the eye
The ceiling beams are oversaturated orange (b_median 4); the fir has no checks or end-grain detail
The counter top's front edge has a hot near-clipping highlight band (p95 244)
The counter's fluted timber and the stools are clean and uniform; the brass footrail reads as rope-like CG

changes.problem: Mother EARF reads as neon hoops because the rim self-glow, not the spot, carries the discs, so the acrylic faces never read.

evidence.measured: median 38, p95 114; the rims are saturated tubes and the disc faces are near-transparent at 3x crop

changes.expected: The rims read as polished edges catching the hard spot, with the colour carried by light through the discs and by the shadow; the globe reads as an object, not signage

changes.problem: Back-bar Tropos speakers are too dark to read as the product.

evidence.measured: lum_median 29.2, p5 4.4, crush 0.9 %; the left niche [890,250,930,420] is at 62.7

change.setting: the record wall spots (and re-aim one per niche at the speaker face)
change.from: 4 x spot 6.0 W, 2400 K, cone 26 deg
change.to: 4 x spot 12.0 W, 2400 K, cone 22 deg, two aimed into the niches at the cabinets

changes.expected: Both niche speakers show their smoked acrylic, the white batts behind and a horn highlight; niche medians 45 to 70

changes.problem: The Orbs clip to neutral white and lose their smoked tint and liner.

change.setting: each Orb power and liner glow

changes.expected: The Orbs read as smoked acrylic with a warm frosted core, about 160 to 200 median, still the brightest points on the banquette

changes.problem: The coloured shadow on the wall is overexposed and pastel, out-shining the globe that casts it.

evidence.measured: lum_median 134.5, p95 208, against a frame median of 31

changes.expected: The shadow keeps saturated colour (median about 85 to 105) and sits as a pool on the concrete, not a projected slide

changes.problem: The floor reads as a smeared, blotchy CG texture rather than polished concrete.

evidence.measured: median 26.9 with a visible low-frequency mottle at 2x crop; no aggregate, saw cuts or reflection of the pendants

change.setting: the floor's polish and concrete tone
change.to: honed concrete, roughness 0.35 with fine aggregate (texture scale about 4x finer, mottle contrast halved) and soft reflections of the counter glow; render samples 256 to 512 so the denoiser smears less

changes.expected: The floor carries soft elongated reflections under the counter and the Orbs and reads as concrete at 1:1; the pool along the bar lifts slightly

changes.problem: The grade pushes everything orange, so the concrete and fir lose their neutral warm grey and the globe is the only thing that is not orange.
changes.expected: Concrete reads warm grey and the fir honey-brown; the lamps stay warm. Floor b_median rises to about 22 or more

changes.problem: Visible haze shafts from the spots are a render and nightclub tell in a low, small room.

evidence.measured: a distinct light shaft across the beams, plus a second at [870,60,960,200]

changes.expected: A faint atmosphere with no discrete beams; the beams' undersides read cleanly

changes.problem: Two crushed foreground tub-chair masses eat the bottom of the frame and read as unlit CG blobs.

change.to: [13.7, 3.0, 1.40], 32 mm, same target, so only a sliver of a chair back stays at the left edge as a seated-viewpoint cue; or place a candle/votive on the near side table to model the leather

changes.expected: The bottom edge holds floor and the near chair reads as leather, with no region over a tenth of the frame more than half crushed

out_of_scope.request: Make Mother EARF's discs visibly thicker, with faces of more saturated tinted acrylic, so the globe reads as 25 mm cast acrylic rather than wire hoops
out_of_scope.why: It is EARF's product (shape, colour, parts) and fixed; only its light can change here

out_of_scope.request: Reduce the globe to one tint to meet the one-colour rule
out_of_scope.why: The owner chose the six tints; the room's design and the product are fixed

out_of_scope.request: Vary the five identical Orbs, and the uniform stools and banquette, so they read less like a catalogue
out_of_scope.why: The furniture and EARF's lamps are part of the fixed design; only props can add variety (add a glass, a menu, a coat at two of the tables)

out_of_scope.request: Add checks, nail holes and end grain to the fir beams, and tie holes and pour lines to the concrete walls
out_of_scope.why: This is a material finish detail that may be within 'the materials' finish', but it goes beyond tone and sheen into texture assets; flagged for the owner
